Priya: Heads-up: external pentest on 2026-06-10 09:00-16:00 UTC. Need RBAC lockdown window, KMS proxy plan, immutable audit snapshot, and single evidence handoff owner. Volunteers?

Dave: I can own RBAC lockdown + rollback. Propose lockdown 08:45-16:30 UTC for pre/post buffers. Will list affected service principals before EOD.

Maria: KMS approach: proxy role assumed by assessor acct, only kms:Decrypt on specific S3 objects. No key material shared. Need assessor AWS account and allowed prefixes.

Liam: Assessor acct 444433332222. Platform: can you produce a tarball snapshot of CloudTrail + host logs for the window and publish sha256? Object lock enabled for snapshot.

Ops Bot: Created ticket SEC-PT-5120. Assignees: @Dave, @Maria. Rotation pause scheduled for alias/pt-evidence-key during window.

Priya: Acceptance checks: RBAC applied, KMS proxy enforced, snapshot exported + sha256 matches, oncall triage path confirmed. Add one-line criteria to SEC-PT-5120 by EOD. Pre-walk Wed 08:00 UTC 10m.

Dave: Added: "Lockdown applied + rollback tested."

Maria: Added: "KMS proxy confirmed; no rotations during window."

Liam: Added: "Snapshot tar.gz created and checksum published."

Priya: Thanks team. Ping here for any last-minute changes. :thumbsup:
